input.endpoint_rule: 0<=u,v<n and u!=v; parallel and antiparallel arcs allowed

algorithm_profile.residual_graph: Aggregate parallel input capacities in a directed n-by-n residual matrix; initialize R[u][v] to the sum of capacities for each directed input arc u->v.
algorithm_profile.tree_growth: Initialize active FIFO queue [s,t]. Pop vertices FIFO and scan neighbors by ascending ID. Source-tree u grows over R[u][v]>0; sink-tree u grows backward over R[v][u]>0. Add a free neighbor to the active tree. On first opposite-tree encounter, record the oriented source-to-sink bridge and end growth.
algorithm_profile.bridge_resumption: After finding a bridge, requeue its active endpoint at the queue tail before augmentation, so unscanned neighbors remain eligible after tree adoption.
algorithm_profile.augmentation: Join the source parent chain, bridge, and sink parent chain; subtract the path bottleneck from each forward residual and add it to the reverse residual. Queue saturated tree children as orphans in source-to-sink path order.
algorithm_profile.orphan_adoption: Process orphans FIFO. Choose the lowest-ID same-tree parent with a positive parent-to-orphan residual edge and a positive-residual parent chain to its tree root. If none exists, free the orphan, activate same-tree neighbors with a positive parent-to-orphan edge in ascending ID order, and enqueue former children as orphans in ascending ID order.
algorithm_profile.complexity: Let C be the sum of input capacities leaving s; C<=240 and at most C augmentations occur. The bounded profile uses O((C+1)*n^4) worst-case time and O(n^2+m) auxiliary space for n<=8.
algorithm_profile.tie_breaking: Active and orphan queues are FIFO; all vertex scans use ascending vertex ID; replacement-parent adoption chooses the lowest eligible vertex ID.

output.meaning: Maximum s-to-t flow value; -1 for invalid input.
